summary: Revised Phase A to establish a concrete, screen-by-screen enterprise implementation blueprint, conforming strictly to the required reporting schema. Replaced generic SaaS visuals with a crisp, structured operational system.

visual_direction.layout: Enterprise-density layouts with explicit structural borders. Eradicated excessive rounded cards, gradients, and unstructured floating panels. Replaced with a crisp, persistent staff application shell and structured data tables. Patient/caregiver views use focused, linear single-column layouts.
visual_direction.color: Light background direction maintained (Slate-50 canvases, White panels). Removed generic SaaS gradients. Strict semantic color usage (Indigo for primary navigation, Amber for active blockers, Emerald for resolved states) with high-contrast text.
visual_direction.typography: Standardized sizing. Eliminated tiny uppercase labels. Utilized robust headings and tabular figures for clinical data, identifiers, and temporal metrics.
visual_direction.spacing_and_shape: Sharp, intentional geometry (4px/8px radii maximum). Dense information packing for staff (4px grid), breathable pacing for patients (8px grid). Strong use of 1px borders instead of generic drop shadows.
visual_direction.component_presentation: Signature elements: Treatment Readiness Graph, Owned Action Workflow panels, Caregiver Permission Boundaries, and Causal Audit Timeline. Avoided repetitive feature grids and unverified Unsplash portraits.

motion.strategy: Motion is bounded to causal meaning and state changes. No ambient morphing or indefinite pulsing. CSS-driven causal path on landing to communicate the product story.
motion.transitions: 0ms structural transitions in the staff shell for operational speed. 300ms layout transition for readiness split. 400ms color transition for graph resolution.
motion.microinteractions: Clear, high-contrast focus states. 100ms background color fades for buttons. No per-second tick re-renders for countdowns.
motion.reduced_motion: Full prefers-reduced-motion compliance with 0ms instant state changes. Meaning relies entirely on border colors, icons, and text labels.

responsive.notes: Staff shell optimized for desktop/tablet landscape (1024px+) with dense data presentation. Public site, sign-in, patient, and caregiver portals are fully responsive, scaling down to 320px mobile viewports with 44px touch targets.

application_states: Public/Unauthenticated: High-credibility public website with causal path story, trust center, and sign-in.
Staff App Shell - Command Center: High-level operational view.
Staff App Shell - Exceptions: Active deterministic state engine (Maria's case, dual-task split, triage, confirmation).
Staff App Shell - Secondary: Illustrative presentation of Insights, Integrations, Resources, and Admin.
Patient Portal: Maria's active readiness check.
Caregiver Portal: Ana's permission-filtered view of confirmed ride without clinical exposure.
Deterministic Reset: Global state reset restoring baseline scenario.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast ratios strictly enforced.
Explicit navigation labels and ARIA landmarks in the staff shell.
No reliance on color alone for readiness states or exceptions.
Visible 2px focus indicators on all interactive elements without generic glows.
Caregiver DOM/ARIA exclusion of clinical text strictly enforced.
Minimum 44px touch targets on mobile viewports.
assets_or_dependencies: Lucide React (clinical and enterprise system icons)
Tailwind CSS (utility classes, structural layouts, strict enterprise tokens)
design_system_changes: Expanded docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md to define the persistent enterprise staff shell, distinct patient/caregiver portal containers, and public website structural tokens.
Appended a comprehensive Screen-by-Screen Blueprint detailing purpose, interactions, illustrative records, and states for all public and enterprise routes.
Updated terminology to reflect human clinical authority (e.g., 'Review requested' instead of 'Clearance') and explicitly framed integrations as 'FHIR mappings' or 'proposed data flows'.
